description: This file contains helper functions for handling V4L2 (Video4Linux2) video streaming, including format printing, frame size calculations, device initialization, and a test stream function. It is part of the 'cuttlefish' namespace and interacts with Linux video device APIs.

methods.name: V4l2GetBpp
methods.description: Returns bytes per pixel for a given V4L2 pixel format, currently only supports BGRX32.

methods.name: V4l2GetFrameSize
methods.description: Calculates the total frame size in bytes based on format, width, and height.

methods.name: V4l2GetLineWidth
methods.description: Calculates the line width in bytes for a given format and width.

methods.name: V4l2PrintFormat
methods.description: Prints the details of a v4l2_format structure for debugging.

methods.name: V4l2ReadRawFile
methods.description: Reads a raw binary file into a buffer.

methods.name: V4l2InitDevice
methods.description: Initializes a V4L2 device with specified format, width, and height.

methods.name: V4l2StreamFile
methods.description: Streams raw video frames from a file directly to a V4L2 device for debugging/testing.
